subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` suppress explicit supervised Gateway `update.run` managed handoffs, or remain scoped to configured background auto-update applies only?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the choice changes a public operator contract: explicit update requests currently bypass the auto-update kill-switch and use the managed handoff for safety.

options.title: Extend the existing kill-switch
options.body: Treat the env var as a package-update restart kill-switch across configured auto-update and supervised `update.run`, returning an explicit disabled result before creating a handoff.

options.title: Keep auto-only scope
options.body: Preserve current explicit `update.run` behavior and strengthen docs/runbooks so operators understand that the env var only disables configured background applies.

options.title: Design a separate control-plane update policy
options.body: Leave the existing env var unchanged and add a maintainer-approved policy surface for disabling or approval-gating explicit `update.run`.

recommendation.title: Extend the existing kill-switch
recommendation.body: Treat the env var as a package-update restart kill-switch across configured auto-update and supervised `update.run`, returning an explicit disabled result before creating a handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the kill-switch and recently carried the supervised auto-update handoff repair.
